description: This file defines the Microsphone Capture and Speech Recognition management for an Android app, including handling recognition sessions, gateway communication, and conversational state.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: Enumerates user and assistant roles in a conversation.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: Represents an individual message in a voice conversation, with role, text, and streaming status.

classes.name: MicCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages microphone recognition sessions, speech recognition, and communication with a chat gateway, maintaining conversation state and handling recognition lifecycle events.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables microphone listening and manages recognition sessions accordingly.

methods.name: pauseForTts
methods.description: Pauses recognition for text-to-speech output to prevent interference.

methods.name: resumeAfterTts
methods.description: Resumes recognition after TTS output is complete.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events from the chat gateway, updating conversation state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts speech recognition session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing recognition session and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startListeningSession
methods.description: Configures and begins a recognition session.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of speech recognition after errors or end of session.

methods.name: queueRecognizedMessage
methods.description: Queues a recognized speech string for processing and conversation update.

methods.name: scheduleTranscriptFlush
methods.description: Schedules flush of partial transcript after a timeout.

methods.name: publishQueue
methods.description: Updates the observable list of queued messages.

methods.name: sendQueuedIfIdle
methods.description: Sends the next message in queue if recognition is idle.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for awaiting gateway response, to retry or abandons the current run.

methods.name: completePendingTurn
methods.description: Marks the current message turn as completed, removes from queue.

methods.name: appendConversation
methods.description: Adds a new message entry to the conversation state.

methods.name: updateConversationEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing conversation message by ID.

methods.name: upsertPendingAssistant
methods.description: Inserts or updates the assistant's message in conversation.

methods.name: playAssistantReplyAsync
methods.description: Speaks out the assistant's text reply asynchronously.

methods.name: disableMic
methods.description: Disables microphone and cleans up recognition resources.
